profile.label: Continuous default benchmark
profile.description: Pinned benchmark profile for automated continuous collection on shared GitHub-hosted runners.
expectations: Build the Nest application before running the collector.
Keep the benchmark request on POST /export/benchmark for fair dataset reuse across implementations.
Prefer a clean git worktree for publishable runs.

memory.note: memoryDeltaBytes reports Node heap deltas only; Go/Rust WASM linear memory is not instrumented in this benchmark.

exceljs.label: ExcelJS
exceljs.executionModel: Streams rows directly to the Node writable via ExcelJS WorkbookWriter.

goWasm.label: Go/WASM
goWasm.executionModel: Accumulates workbook state inside Go/WASM and emits ZIP bytes during finalization callbacks.

rustWasm.label: Rust/WASM
rustWasm.executionModel: Accumulates workbook state inside Rust/WASM and returns final workbook bytes to Node at finalize time.
